reason: I'll download it and try it once because the pay-on-delivery escrow is the first real answer I've seen to the JustDial problem -- a dead-end number can't cost me money if I never release the payment. But I'm only testing it on one small job, not betting on it.
objection: Is the app actually built in Tamil, or is it English software with translated labels bolted on -- and with only a handful of verified pros near me right now, will I even find someone good for what I need?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a decent number of real completed jobs and ratings from people near me in Coimbatore/Chennai, not just the badge, and confirming the Tamil in the app actually reads like Tamil and not a translation.
